title: Robustness of image classifiers to adversarial perturbations
description: Deep neural network image classifiers can be fooled by adversarial examples - inputs perturbed by small, often imperceptible amounts that cause confident misclassification. As of the source work, there was no training method that reliably hardened classifiers against such perturbations: defenses either failed against stronger attacks or sacrificed substantial clean accuracy, and no approach offered robustness that generalized across different perturbation types and attack budgets.
canonical_description: no method makes image classifiers reliably robust to adversarial perturbations without large accuracy loss or across threat models

evidence.quote: We have so far been unable to design a training procedure that makes a model robust to adversarial examples without significantly degrading its accuracy on clean inputs.
